content.comment_body: Hello, The clock in [product_name] is backed up by a capacitor lasting up to 80 hours (ultracapacitor). If issues arise with this solution, you may consider using a battery card: [url] Alternatively, a battery or battery/memory card can be used: [url] Regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clear information about the internal clock backup in [company_name] [product_name]. There is confusion about whether a capacitor or battery is used, and users are exploring options such as adding a battery or memory card for longer backup duration when needed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users prefer an extended and dependable clock backup, ideally with an internal battery or another solution that provides more backup time than the default capacitor.
